asset.calculator: An interactive calculator for my niche that helps visitors work something out.
asset.leadform: A sign-up section that invites visitors to get in touch.
asset.pricing: A pricing table with my packages.
asset.hero: A hero section for the top of my website: a headline, a short text and a button.
asset.countdown: A countdown to a date I give.
asset.quiz: A short quiz that recommends one of my offers.
asset.checklist: An interactive checklist visitors can tick.
asset.testimonials: A section showing testimonials, only the ones in my request.
asset.booking: A section that shows my services and lets people book through my booking link.
asset.spreadsheet: A simple interactive table that works like a small spreadsheet.
asset.faq: An FAQ section with the questions and answers in my request.
asset.roi: A calculator that shows the time or money my offer saves, from numbers the visitor enters.

seo.lead: A lead form page: a short pitch and one contact form.
seo.booking: A booking page: my services, and Book buttons that open my booking link (or a short “Request a time” form when I have no booking link).
seo.website: A one-page website with a top menu: Home, Services, About and Contact.
seo.landing: A landing page: one offer and one call to action.
seo.showcase: A showcase page: what I sell, with photos, and a button for each.
seo.checkout: A checkout page: one offer, what's included, the price and a Buy now button that opens my payment link.
